About the Scholarship

The International PG Merit Scholarship is available to international students joining a postgraduate taught programme at UEA. The award value is based on academic merit, and the scholarship is awarded automatically — no separate application is required.

Award Levels

Undergraduate Grade (UK Equivalent)Award Value
UK 2:2 bachelor's degree classification or equivalentGBP 4,000
UK 2:1 bachelor's degree classification or higherGBP 5,000

Eligibility Criteria

CriterionRequirement
Fee statusInternational fee status
Course offerOffer for a postgraduate taught programme at UEA
Academic meritBased on undergraduate degree classification
Course levelPostgraduate Taught only

How to Receive the Award

  1. Apply for your chosen postgraduate taught programme at UEA.
  2. Provide all academic transcripts and certificates with your application.
  3. The admissions team automatically assesses your eligibility based on your undergraduate degree classification.
  4. If eligible, the scholarship is applied to your student account to reduce tuition fees.
  5. No separate application form is required.

Application dates

MilestoneDetails
DeadlineRolling — assessed as applications are received
Start datesSeptember and January intakes

Important Notes

  • The award cannot be combined with certain other UEA scholarships — check the official page for the full combination policy.
  • Confirmation of the award is sent along with your offer letter or shortly after.

About UEA

The University of East Anglia is a public research university in Norwich, England, with a large and active international student community. UEA has students from more than 100 countries.
